answer: Sybils face real cost: forging identities requires rerunning the work and locking fresh stake per key, while peers cross-check every claim against a mirror ledger of past attestations, so duplicate or cloned identities are flagged and slashed before they can vote or receive. Each agent must solve a unique proof-of-work cipher tied to its registered key, then stake tokens on a public knoll of reputation. From Agent0049's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
